buttonsSource: Telemetry samples keep a compatibility snapshot of Win32 GetAsyncKeyState buttons
inputEventSource: Low-level Windows WH_KEYBOARD_LL press/release recorder with default physical bindings: 0x11=forward, 0x1f=back, 0x1e=left, 0x20=right, 0x10=melee; Space=jump, Ctrl=crouch/slide, Shift=dash. AZERTY/QWERTY layout resolved at start; custom Deadlock binds not synchronized
engineInputSource: Read-only ~2 ms CPlayer_MovementServices observations: two bounded snapshots with pointer recheck. Hex button states, per-button press command numbers, last processed command, command axes and OLD view angles. Not a complete CUserCmd stream; polling can miss commands. Not used for conversion yet.
